result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but the system gesture/home indicator bar overlaps the bottom navigation icons, obscuring the search and bookmark icons.

issues.description: The system home-indicator bar (dark rounded bar) is rendered directly on top of the bottom navigation icons, partially obscuring the search and bookmark icons and making them hard to see/tap.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the navigation bar so its icons sit above the system gesture area, or respect the device safe-area insets.
